questions.q: Where was Phileas Fogg held after his arrest?
choices: In the Custom House
In a ship's cabin
At the town hall
In a railway station office
questions.evidence: He had been shut up in the Custom House

questions.q: Why did Passepartout believe he was the cause of this new misfortune?
choices: He had lost the tickets for the London train
He had never told Mr. Fogg who Fix really was
He had told Fix where Mr. Fogg kept the money
He had made them late by stopping to eat
questions.evidence: Had he not concealed Fix's errand from his master?

questions.q: How did Mr. Fogg appear while he sat in the Custom House?
choices: Furious, pounding on the locked door for help
Calm and motionless, without apparent anger
Weeping quietly with his face in his hands
Busy writing a letter to the Reform Club
questions.evidence: seated, motionless, calm, and without apparent anger

questions.q: What did Mr. Fogg notice about his watch when the Custom House clock struck one?
choices: It had stopped during the storm
It was two hours too fast
It had been broken in the arrest
It was exactly one hour slow
questions.evidence: Mr. Fogg observed that his watch was two hours too fast.

questions.q: What did Fix say when he rushed back into the room?
choices: That the real robber had been arrested three days before
That Fogg must go before a judge in London at once
That the Bank wanted Fogg to pay back the money
That Passepartout had been arrested by the police as well
questions.evidence: robber arrested three days ago--you are free!

questions.q: What did Mr. Fogg do right after learning he was free?
choices: He thanked Fix and shook him warmly by the hand
He knocked Fix down with one quick motion
He ran straight out to find a cab for the station
He sat down again and wrote in his journal
questions.evidence: with the precision of a machine knocked Fix down

questions.q: Why did Mr. Fogg have to order a special train?
choices: The express train had already left
No trains ran to London on Saturdays
The police would not let him ride with others
Aouda was too tired to travel on a crowded train
questions.evidence: The express train had left thirty-five minutes before.

choices: Fogg reaches London five minutes late and believes he has lost
Fogg reaches the Reform Club just in time to win his bet
Fogg's special train breaks down far outside of London
Fogg decides to go back to Liverpool to find Fix again
questions.evidence: Having made the tour of the world, he was behind-hand five minutes.
